title: Failing store tests hang node --test
body:
Run single test files with node --test --test-force-exit and a timeout. A failing assertion before store.close() leaves the SQLite handle open and the process never exits, hiding the failure output. Scripts that open a store must end with process.exit.

Why: On 2026-09-22 a deliberately failing tests/mcp/tools.test.js hung past the 120 s tool timeout with no output; rerunning with --test-force-exit showed the assertion immediately. A measurement script that opened createMemoryStore without process.exit also stayed alive and locked the copied index.sqlite.

evidence.summary: store.close() is called at the end of each test, not in a finally/after hook

v1.trigger: When running a single DD test file with node --test and it never finishes, or when an assertion fails before store.close()
